questions.question: In his letter to the Romans, how does Paul describe himself when he compares himself to God's law?

answers.text: Unspiritual and sold as a slave to sin
Spiritual and ready to keep the law
Strong and free from the pull of sin

questions.question: Paul wrote about his struggle with sin. What principle did he discover when he wanted to do good?

answers.text: Evil is right there with him
Good gets easier the more he tries
Sin leaves him alone when he obeys

questions.question: Paul cried out that he was a wretched man caught in a struggle with sin. What did he ask?

answers.text: Who will rescue him from this body of death
Who will lift the weight of the law from him
Who will judge him for this war within

questions.question: In his letter to the Romans, who did Paul thank after crying out about his struggle with sin?

answers.text: God through Jesus Christ our Lord
Moses who gave Israel the law
Gamaliel who taught him the law
